title: kblane.path_lane classes any top-level file kb/<file> as content, not only a submodule root's gitlink
goal: kblane.py classes the gitlink of a submodule root as content and a plain top-level file of kb/ (kb/foo.md, kb/.gitignore) as code, reading the entry's git mode (160000) where the path alone cannot tell (SP-c6w5hjmc review gap 8; the gate answer of BG-qgulx5sj chose the bare path and this narrows it)

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kblane
lane = kblane.path_lane("kb/foo.md")
print("lane of a top-level file kb/foo.md:", lane)
sys.exit(0 if lane == "code" else 1)
